notes: Ground truth values were transcribed by visually inspecting each image,
not generated programmatically — unlike ground_truth.json (the synthetic
set), a transcription error here is possible, particularly for small or
angled chassis numbers (see 'confidence' per document below).
'source' records what kind of document this actually is: several of the
documents supplied turned out to be third-party KYC-vendor mockup/sample
than genuine issued documents — both kinds are included and scored the
same way, since the pipeline can't tell the difference and shouldn't be
expected to; 'source' is recorded for transparency, not to exclude them.
Documents excluded entirely (see 'excluded' below) are ones where the
field itself is redacted, blank, absent, or illegible in the source
image — there is no correct value to score extraction against.
